question: Which Mn-doped LNO generated less heat in the thermal decomposition tests, the 10% or the 50% Mn sample?
rendered: The 10% Mn sample generated less heat in the thermal decomposition tests, producing 901.4 J g−1, compared to 485.7 J g−1 for the 50% Mn sample.
